## YouTube scraper → Google Sheets

**Setup (once):** paste your Google Sheet URL in **CONFIG**, select the *Google Sheets* credential on the 4 Sheets nodes and the *YouTube API Key* (Query Auth) credential on the 3 YouTube nodes.

**First run** creates the **Inputs** tab (with 2 examples) and the **Videos** tab automatically.

**Inputs tab, column A** accepts: search words · video URL (watch / youtu.be / shorts) · playlist URL · channel @handle or /channel/UC… URL. Column B = max videos (1–50), column C = FALSE to pause a row. Columns D–F are written back with Last Run / Status / Videos Found.

**Videos tab:** one row per video (title, channel, description, publish date, views, likes, comments, duration, tags…). Re-runs **update** existing rows instead of duplicating them.

Uses the official YouTube Data API v3 (stable, ToS-compliant — no HTML scraping that breaks).
